title: Night Cream vs Serum: What Is the Difference and Do You Need Both?
ex: A serum targets one goal; a night cream moisturises and seals it in. How they differ, which you need more, and how to pair night cream with niacinamide serum.
rt: Night Cream vs Serum: Differences & Which You Need | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream vs serum: how they differ in texture and job, which your skin needs more, and how to use night cream with niacinamide serum the right way.
quick: A serum is a light, concentrated liquid that delivers one or two active ingredients. A night cream is a richer moisturiser that helps skin hold water overnight. They work together: serum first on clean skin, then night cream. If your night cream already has actives, a serum is optional.
facts: Apply serum first, then night cream
Serums rarely moisturise enough on their own
Many night creams already contain niacinamide
Use one active serum per night
